questions_for_hospital: Has psychiatry cleared him as stable for a congregate setting, and has he had any aggression or command hallucinations since starting risperidone 09/04?
Is he still on a 1:1 sitter, and what is the outcome of the daily 5150 reassessment?
Could you please send a negative COVID swab taken within 24 hours of arrival?
Will the wound need dressing changes before the 09/11 suture removal, and who will do them?
Can you confirm he will take cephalexin and risperidone on his own, and will a 30-day supply be sent?

claude_fit.reason: The infection itself fits (INT-E1, INT-E5, ID-1), but the chart documents aggression toward staff on 09/03 and 09/04 (OTH-1, FORM-X7) and command hallucinations to harm others with an unstabilized schizophrenia exacerbation (MH-3, MH-1). The COVID swab was also refused (INF-2), and psychiatry advises against discharge to a congregate setting.
